    {

        int m = in.nextInt();
        if(n > m)

            n = m;
            m = t;
        }

        int size = 1 << n;
        int[][] curr = new int[size][size];
        for (int[] row : curr) Arrays.fill(row, oo);
        Arrays.fill(curr[0], 0);

        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++)
        {
            int[][] next = new int[size][size];
            for (int[] row : next) Arrays.fill(row, oo);
            int c2Limit = (j == m - 1) ? 1 : size;
            IntStream.range(0, size).forEach(c0 ->
                IntStream.range(0, size).forEach(c1 -> {
                    int val = curr[c0][c1];
                    if (val != oo)
                    {
                        IntStream.range(0, c2Limit).forEach(c2 -> {
                            int all = size - 1;
                            int done = (all & (c1 >> 1)) | (all & (c1 << 1)) | c0 | c2;
                            done &= (all ^ c1);
                            int newVal = val + n - Integer.bitCount(done);
                            if (newVal < next[c1][c2])
                                next[c1][c2] = newVal;

        }

        int res = oo;
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++)
                res = Math.min(res, curr[i][j]);

        System.out.println(n * m - res);
